name: Rover crosses the lab
first_frame: A clean, modern robotics research lab seen from one side. Pale concrete floor with a painted yellow travel lane running left to right across the middle of the room. A small white four-wheeled rover with a black sensor mast is parked at the left end of the lane. Nobody is in the room.
lighting: Cool, even overhead LED light with soft floor reflections and gentle shadows under the benches.
view: Static side view from the near wall at standing eye height, framing the whole travel lane from the rover on the left to the charging dock on the right.

subjects.name: Rover
subjects.attribute: Small white four-wheeled rover with rubber tyres and a short black sensor mast.

events.description: The rover pulls away and drives steadily along the yellow lane from left to right, its wheels turning, and slows to a stop in front of the charging dock.

actions.action: drives along the yellow lane from left to right at a steady pace.
slows and stops in front of the charging dock.
